purpose: Source-authored predicate contract for custom law profiles that depend on kill, loss, sacrifice, plunder, or low-loss event correlation. This is planning evidence only; it does not prove death/casualty event ordering or authorize gameplay mutation.
requiredRuntimeProof: temporary gated loss versus permanent casualty discriminator proof

cove.crew-momentum.notes: Cove morale momentum requires event-specific correlation before applying morale, Focus, or speed.

cove.kill-plunder-cannon-momentum-packag.notes: Cove morale package requires proving the same specific momentum events as the trigger profile, not generic kill/loss state.

forbiddenSubstitutes: temporary gated loss counted as permanent casualty
inferno.death-sacrifice-gated-loss-momen.notes: Inferno morale trigger requires proving the loss/sacrifice/gated-loss identity before granting momentum.

forbiddenSubstitutes: temporary gated loss counted as permanent casualty
inferno.death-sacrifice-gating-momentum-.notes: Inferno morale package requires proving permanent casualties, sacrifices, and temporary gated losses as distinct event types.

forbiddenSubstitutes: generic low casualty count without committed battle result
rampart.protect-preserve-avenger-momentu.notes: Rampart morale momentum requires preservation or native Avenger/protection context, not generic kills.

forbiddenSubstitutes: generic low casualty count without committed battle result
rampart.protect-preserve-avenger-package.notes: Rampart morale package requires proving Defender's Grace event semantics and cannot collapse into flat morale.

stronghold.damage-kill-tempo.notes: Stronghold morale trigger requires kill tempo or damage-taken correlation before speed/damage tempo effects.

stronghold.damage-kill-rage-package.notes: Stronghold morale package can use rage/kill tempo only after the source event and safe application timing are proven.
